newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Motorola says Alphatec links exaggerated.
newsitem.headline: Motorola says Alphatec links exaggerated.

text.p: Technology giant Motorola Inc said on Wednesday news reports it was interested in investing in the financially-beleaguered Alphatec Group of Thailand were exaggerated.
"Some of the headlines that I've seen in articles are an overstatement of Motorola's present situation," company chairman Gary Tooker told Reuters.
He said some Motorola executives had visited Alphatec after Texas Instruments in two joint ventures with the Thai firm Alphatec Group.
Texas Instruments said it had terminated the ventures because difficult conditions in Thailand.
"If you have a situation where another company just pulled out, then it makes sense to go in and look and have discussions ... which our people are doing constantly," he said.
Motorola is currently having several discussions in other economies in the region, but he declined to give details.
"We are constantly looking at our various businesses and putting in facilities in places where we hope to penetrate those markets," he added.
At present, 28 percent of its sales come from its Asian operations.
